_doc: Multi-Spirling battle extras (docs/KAMPF_PLAN_1000.md, Mehrfachkämpfe), read by scripts/battle/MultiRules.gd. formation: when a side fields at least 'count' Spirlings of 'element' at the start of a battle with several slots, each of them starts with these stat stages. tower: every 'every'-th lighthouse stair floor that is no Warden floor is fought 'front' against 'front'. support_turns: default turns of the support arts (team_guard, decoy, cover). guard_mult: damage taken by a side under a team guard.
